description: A user is planning a multi-stage life relocation: moving to a new country for work, then bringing their parents over 3 years later. They need to track changing immigration policies and savings goals over a long horizon to ensure the family reunion is feasible.

user_profile.context: Phase 1 of a multi-year family migration plan
user_profile.communication_style: Patient, focused on long-term stability and contingency planning

fact_sheet.fact: Elara Vance's Skilled Worker Visa for the Republic of Aethelgard, number AE-SW-88432, is valid from March 15, 2024, to March 14, 2029.
The 'Family Reunification Visa (Parental)' in Aethelgard currently requires the sponsoring child to have 5 years of continuous, documented residency before applying.
Elara's immigration consultant is Julian Croft of Croft Immigration Partners, reachable at j.croft@croftip.com.
A recurring calendar event is set for the 1st of every quarter to check the official Aethelgard Immigration Ministry website for policy changes; the next check is scheduled for July 1, 2024.
The target savings for the parents' (Liam and Sofia Vance) relocation is 75,000 Aethelgardian Crowns (AEC) by March 1, 2027.
The 'Family Relocation Fund' is held in a high-yield savings account (#45-882-109) at Meridian Trust Bank, currently holding 12,550 AEC.
An automatic transfer of 1,500 AEC is scheduled from Elara's checking account to the Family Relocation Fund on the 28th of each month.
A separate emergency fund of 20,000 AEC is maintained in account #45-882-110 at Meridian Trust Bank for unexpected travel or legal fees.
Elara's annual gross salary at Starkweather & Thorne Architects is 110,000 Aethelgardian Crowns (AEC).
Elara Vance is employed as a Project Architect at the firm Starkweather & Thorne Architects in the city of Silverwood.
Elara's official start date at Starkweather & Thorne Architects was April 1, 2024.
Elara resides at Apartment 14B, The Azure Spire, 255 Skyview Lane, Silverwood, Aethelgard, Postal Code SW7 3PQ.
The monthly rent for Apartment 14B is 2,200 AEC, payable to Silverwood Property Group.
The current lease for Apartment 14B is a 24-month term, ending on March 31, 2026.
Elara registered her residency at the Silverwood Civic Registry on April 5, 2024, and received Resident ID card #AGR-901-773-C.
A secure digital folder named 'Vance_Family_Docs_2027' on a password-protected drive contains scanned copies of her parents' birth certificates and passports.
Elara's Aethelgardian Tax Identification Number (ATIN) is 440-815-921.
Elara has a notarized power of attorney document for her parents' financial affairs in their home country, dated February 10, 2024.
Elara is covered under the 'Aethelgard Premier Health Plan' provided by her employer, policy number ST-HP-EV31.
Her registered primary care physician is Dr. Aris Thorne at the Silverwood General Clinic, located at 12 Civic Plaza.
Research indicates that non-resident parents over 65 must have private health insurance with a minimum coverage of 100,000 AEC per person to qualify for a visa.
The apartment has a 1 Gbps fiber internet plan with AetherLink Broadband, account number AL-SV-77592, for 85 AEC per month.
Elara's mobile phone number is +441 883 204 917, with provider ConnectaMobile on the 'Global Connect 50' plan.
Elara attends an intermediate Aethelgardian language class at the Silverwood Community Center every Tuesday from 7:00 PM to 8:30 PM.
Elara has a scheduled video call with her parents, Liam and Sofia Vance, every Sunday at 15:00 UTC.
25% of Elara's monthly savings transfer (375 AEC) is invested in a low-risk index fund named 'Meridian Global 100' to hedge against inflation.
Elara's primary checking account at Meridian Trust Bank is account number 45-791-330.
Elara's direct manager at Starkweather & Thorne Architects is Anya Sharma, Head of Residential Design.
